def find(color, rmin, rmax):
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:

            rows=[q[0] for q in n['boundary']]; cols=[q[1] for q in n['boundary']]
            if rmin<=min(rows)<=rmax: return (min(rows),min(cols))
    return None

def try_place(prow,pcol,s1,s2,color,rmin,rmax):
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':prow,'col':pcol}])

        pos=find(color,rmin,rmax); ok = pos is not None

def find(color, rmin, rmax):
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color and n['pixels']<=20:
            rows=[q[0] for q in n['boundary']]; cols=[q[1] for q in n['boundary']]
            if rmin<=min(rows)<=rmax: return (min(rows),min(cols))
    return None

def try_place(prow,pcol,s1,s2,color,rmin,rmax):
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':prow,'col':pcol}])
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':s1[0],'col':s1[1]}])
    pos=find(color,rmin,rmax); ok = pos is not None
    if not ok:
        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':s2[0],'col':s2[1]}])
        pos=find(color,rmin,rmax); ok = pos is not None
    print(color,'->',pos,'ok' if ok else 'FAIL')
    return ok
